Olive & Thyme Bistro — Dinner Menu

Starters
Tomato Soup (V) — $7
Fried Calamari — $11

Mains
Lemon Herb Chicken with rice — $19
Mushroom Risotto (V, GF) — $17
Grilled Salmon with seasonal vegetables (GF) — $24
Beef Burger with fries — $16 (add cheese $1.50)

Desserts
Chocolate Cake — $8
Fresh Fruit Plate (V, GF) — $6

V = vegetarian   GF = gluten-free
Ask your server about tonight's specials. Please tell your server about any food allergies before ordering. Groups of eight or more will have an 18% service charge added. Tuesday is Pasta Night: all pasta dishes half price.

questions.stem: Which main dish is suitable for a guest who eats neither meat nor fish and cannot have gluten?
questions.explanation: The Mushroom Risotto is marked "(V, GF)," meaning vegetarian and gluten-free. The salmon is gluten-free but not vegetarian.

questions.stem: What are guests asked to do before ordering?
options: C. Mention any allergies to their server
D. Make a reservation for Tuesday
questions.explanation: "Please tell your server about any food allergies before ordering."

questions.stem: What is suggested about the bistro?
options: A. It offers free dessert with every main dish.
B. It is open only on Tuesdays.
C. It does not serve large groups.
D. It serves pasta on some days.
questions.explanation: The menu lists no pasta dishes but announces "Tuesday is Pasta Night," so pasta is served at least on Tuesdays. Large groups are served with an added charge.
